[[File:Justin Desai 2013 Hall of Fame.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Justin Desai, inducted into the Players Committee Hall of Fame in 2013.]]
'''Justin Desai''' (GEMP handle '''allstarz97''')<ref name="cc1" /> won the [[2022 World Championship]], his third World Championship after 2013 and 2015.<ref name="wrap-2022worlds">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-world-championship-wrap-desai-wins-third-title/ 2022 World Championship Wrap – Desai Wins Third Title], starwarsccg.org (22 October 2022). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20221022172043/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-world-championship-wrap-desai-wins-third-title/ Internet Archive]</ref> He is a core member of [[Kashyyyk Train of Dominance]]. He also plays [[Star Wars: Unlimited]].<ref name="swu-melee" /> He won the 21 June 2025 Jump to Lightspeed Planetary Qualifier in Philadelphia (90 players) and the 13 December 2025 Secrets of Power Planetary Qualifier (48 players).<ref name="swu-melee" /> He finished 4th of 473 at the 11 October 2025 Sector Qualifier in Philadelphia.<ref name="swu-melee" />
